statement.text:
Is it true that every variety of groups whose free groups are residually nilpotent
torsion-free, is either soluble or coincides with the variety of all groups? For an
affirmative answer, it is sufficient to show that every variety of Lie algebras over
the field of rational numbers which does not contain any finite-dimensional simple
algebras is soluble.                                                     A. L. Shmel’kin
